correctness.rationale: Rank-one symplectic operators admit an explicit tensor description. Commutation reduces to pairwise alternating orthogonality. An incidence construction yields geometric irreducibility and dimension. At nonzero entries the Veronese covering is etale in odd characteristic; linearized pairings have rank st-C(s+1,2). At zero entries Sym^2(U-perp) gives actual reduced tangent directions. Comparison with dimensions classifies smooth points. Counting uses isotropic Grassmannians and subspace Möbius inversion. Direct matrix enumeration and finite-field tangent elimination corroborated the proof.

value.rationale: The reduced commuting family of minimal symplectic nilpotents is a canonical Lie-theoretic moduli object, and tangent/smoothness loci are significant deformation-theoretic invariants. Its full all-parameter singularity threshold, especially the zero-entry phenomenon and transition at r=n, is a motivated structural classification. The finite-field span distribution is a complementary natural arithmetic interpretation, not the sole value claim.
